006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic;
007
008import dev.metaschema.core.datatype.IDataTypeAdapter;
009import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.DynamicContext;
010import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.ComparisonFunctions;
011import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.ICollectionValue;
012import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type.InvalidTypeMetapathException;
013import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
014import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
015import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
016
017/**
018 * Provides base functionality for atomic item implementations.
019 *
020 * @param <TYPE>
021 *          the Java type of the underlying data value
022 */
023public abstract class AbstractAtomicItemBase<TYPE> implements IAnyAtomicItem {
024
025  @Override
026  @NonNull
027  public abstract IDataTypeAdapter<TYPE> getJavaTypeAdapter();
028
029  @Override
030  public String asString() {
031    return getJavaTypeAdapter().asString(getValue());
032  }
033
034  @Override
035  public String toSignature() {
036    return ObjectUtils.notNull(new StringBuilder()
037        .append(getType().toSignature())
038        .append('(')
039        .append(getValueSignature())
040        .append(')')
041        .toString());
042  }
043
044  /**
045   * Get the string to use for the item's value in the item's signature.
046   *
047   * @return the value string
048   */
049  @NonNull
050  protected abstract String getValueSignature();
051
052  @NonNull
053  @Override
054  public String toString() {
055    return toSignature();
056  }
057
058  @Override
059  public boolean deepEquals(ICollectionValue other, DynamicContext dynamicContext) {
060    return handleDeepEquals(other, dynamicContext);
061  }
062
063  /**
064   * Determine if this and the other value are deeply equal, without relying on
065   * the dynamic context.
066   * <p>
067   * Item equality is defined by the
068   * <a href="https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-deep-equal">XPath 3.1
069   * fn:deep-equal</a> specification.
070   *
071   * @param other
072   *          the other value to compare to this value to
073   * @return the {@code true} if the two values are equal, or {@code false}
074   *         otherwise
075   */
076  @Override
077  public boolean deepEquals(@Nullable ICollectionValue other) {
078    return handleDeepEquals(other, null);
079  }
080
081  private boolean handleDeepEquals(
082      @Nullable ICollectionValue other,
083      @Nullable DynamicContext dynamicContext) {
084    boolean retval;
085    try {
086      retval = other instanceof IAnyAtomicItem
087          && ComparisonFunctions.valueCompairison(
088              this,
089              ComparisonFunctions.Operator.EQ,
090              (IAnyAtomicItem) other,
091              dynamicContext)
092              .toBoolean();
093    } catch (@SuppressWarnings("unused") InvalidTypeMetapathException ex) {
094      // incompatible types are a non-match
095      retval = false;
096    }
097    return retval;
098  }
099}
